=== DOCS-TRUTH (verified against trino.io/docs/467) ===
• Default window frame: `RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW` (peer-grouping on ties).
• FIRST_VALUE: works correctly under default frame (first row of partition is always in-frame).
• LAST_VALUE: under default frame returns CURRENT row's value (or last peer on ties) — to get partition's actual last row, MUST add `ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING`.
• NTH_VALUE: under default frame returns NULL for n > current frame size.
• IGNORE NULLS: keyword placement is AFTER closing args paren, BEFORE OVER. Valid on first_value/last_value/nth_value/lag/lead. Default is RESPECT NULLS (omit IGNORE NULLS to get default; no separate RESPECT NULLS keyword).
• Decimal division to 2dp: `truncate(n*100)/100` (toward zero) OR `round(n, 2)` (HALF_UP); they differ at halfway (1.235→1.23 vs 1.24) and for negatives. Trino `truncate` is 1-arg-only (no 2-arg overload). `TRUNC`/`trunc` is UNREGISTERED (Oracle name).
• Integer division on int/bigint operands TRUNCATES — to force decimal/float division, multiply by `1.0` or CAST one operand to DOUBLE/DECIMAL.
• `round(n, d)` is HALF_UP rounding (same name/sig/semantics as Oracle ROUND).
• UNION: bare UNION = UNION DISTINCT = dedups (full-result implicit DISTINCT). UNION ALL = keeps all rows (streaming concatenation, no dedupe — cheaper). DEFAULT is DISTINCT when neither ALL nor DISTINCT is specified.
• INTERSECT: dedups by default (semi-join semantics).
• EXCEPT: dedups by default (anti-join semantics).
• ROLLUP(a,b) emits `(a,b), (a), ()` — drops trailing columns ONLY. GROUPING values for 2-col ROLLUP: 0 (detail), 1 (region-subtotal), 3 (grand-total) — NEVER 2.
• CUBE(a,b) emits FULL power set: `(a,b), (a), (b), ()` — includes the (a,b) detail row.
• GROUPING SETS ((a),(b),()) emits EXACTLY the 3 listed groupings — hand-picked, NO detail row.
• GROUPING(c1,...,cN) returns integer bitmask: bit=1 means column rolled up, bit=0 means present. Grand total = `2^N − 1` (all bits set).
• GROUP BY references base columns/expressions, not SELECT aliases (rolled aggregates inside ROLLUP/CUBE/GROUPING SETS must repeat the expression).
• FILTER (WHERE ...) is legal per-aggregate row filter. Cannot contain a WINDOW expression in the predicate.
